body: For a Biome ignore before an implicitly continued expression, such as `const x = foo +` followed by `bar;`, `depth` stays zero on the first code line and this loop stops before hashing `bar`. If that continuation changes after approval, the identity remains unchanged and the checker reuses the approval for a different suppressed node. Include implicit continuations in the identity or conservatively invalidate approval when the node boundary is uncertain.

summary: Require user words after the entry
body: When the entry is a one-token settings path, `approved bunfig.toml` passes this check and `approvals()` accepts the resulting record, even though no user words were recorded. Require a separate nonempty user-words portion so the ledger preserves the evidence the runbook says to capture.
